title: BadMoE: Backdooring Mixture-of-Experts LLMs via Routing-Aware Triggers and Task-Underutilized Experts
abstract: arXiv:2504.18598v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures are rapidly becoming the standard for building scalable and efficient large language models (LLMs), thanks to their routing mechanism that activates only a subset of experts for each input. However, the modular structure and sparse activation of experts also introduce new security risks, as manipulating a small portion of experts may influence the behavior. In this work, we study a white-box, task-specific model-supply-chain setting and propose BadMoE, a routing-aware backdoor attack against MoE LLMs. We motivate BadMoE through a routing-aware decomposition of the MoE-layer output, which separates the contributions of the selected target experts from those of the remaining experts. This analysis highlights two measurable factors underlying the attack: the routing mass assigned to the target experts and their relative contribution to the layer output. translated_title: BadMoE：通过路由感知触发器与任务欠利用专家对混合专家大语言模型实施后门攻击
translated_abstract: 混合专家（MoE）架构凭借其路由机制——即对每个输入仅激活一部分专家——正迅速成为构建可扩展且高效大语言模型（LLM）的标准。然而，专家的模块化结构与稀疏激活也引入了新的安全风险，因为操纵一小部分专家就可能影响模型行为。在本工作中，我们研究了白盒、面向特定任务的模型供应链场景，并提出BadMoE，一种针对MoE大语言模型的路由感知后门攻击。我们通过对MoE层输出的路由感知分解来阐述BadMoE的设计动机，该分解将所选目标专家的贡献与其余专家的贡献区分开来。这一分析揭示了攻击背后的两个可度量因素：分配给目标专家的路由质量，以及它们对层输出的相对贡献。基于这一洞察，BadMoE选择……
tldr: 提出了针对混合专家大语言模型的路由感知后门攻击BadMoE，通过对MoE层输出的分解分析目标专家的路由质量与相对贡献两个关键因素，并利用路由感知触发器与任务欠利用专家实现后门植入。
en_tdlr: BadMoE introduces a routing-aware backdoor attack against MoE LLMs, leveraging a decomposition of MoE-layer outputs to identify routing mass and relative contribution of target experts, and planting backdoors via routing-aware triggers and task-underutilized experts.
